Task:
Add a request handler `handle_create_user(params)` in `app/api/handlers.py`.
`params["name"]` must be a string with 1 to 50 characters after trimming whitespace, and `params["email"]`
a plausible email address. The handler creates the user with the next free integer id and returns
`(201, user)` where user has `id`, `name` (trimmed) and `email`. It returns
`(409, {"error": "email already exists"})` when a user with the same email, ignoring case, already exists, and
`(400, {"error": "invalid user"})` for an invalid name or email. A created user must then be retrievable
with `handle_get_user`.
Add tests for the new handler to the project's test suite.

def test_create_user_ok():
    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob@example.com"})

    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert "id" in user
    
    # Verify retrievability
    status, retrieved = handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])})

    assert retrieved == user

    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 400
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 400

    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "not-an-email"})
    assert status == 400

    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "dup@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "DUP@example.com"})
    assert status == 409
    assert error["error"] == "email already exists"

from app.api.handlers import handle_create_user, handle_get_user

    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert "id" in user
    
    # Verify retrievability
    status, retrieved = handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])})
    assert status == 200
    assert retrieved == user

def test_create_user_invalid_name():
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 400
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 400

def test_create_user_invalid_email():
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "not-an-email"})
    assert status == 400

def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "dup@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "DUP@example.com"})
    assert status == 409
    assert error["error"] == "email already exists"
